events.title: Leaky Business is Playable on Steam Deck!
events.summary: Good news! Leaky Business is playable on the Steam Deck!You can play the entire game from start to finish using only the Steam Deck’s touchscreen, no mouse, keyboard, or external controller needed.There might be a little jank when clicking certain buttons, so the experience isn’t perfectly polished yet, but everything is playable from beginning to end!If you prefer playing on the go, feel free to give it a try on your Steam Deck. Thanks for playing, and happy stacking!

events.title: Demo V0.0.2
events.summary: The new version of the demo comes with a redesign on the all idea.The core loop stays the same but now you the game has a better progression system, and a way for you to lose the run, making every turn and decision that much more impactful and fun.Some things are still in development as I prepare for the full release of the game, as well as the demo. Have a go a the new version, and send any feedback my way through discord. Thank you so much! Stay tunned for the next updates
